newsitem.title: FRANCE: BASKETBALL-PAU-ORTHEZ COMPLETE YEAR UNBEATEN AT HOME.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PAU-ORTHEZ COMPLETE YEAR UNBEATEN AT HOME.

text.p: Pau-Orthez extended their unbeaten run at home to a year with a crushing 94-71 victory over Dynamo Moscow in EuroLeague group D on Thursday.
The French champions maintained their challenge with their eighth consecutive victory -- four in the EuroLeague and four in domestic competition.
Pau dominated the Russian side, bottom of the group with only one victory in six matches, from start to finish despite the absence of injured American Corey Crowder.
Antoine Rigaudeau, ably supported by Norwegian Torgeir Bryn, scored 21 of his 23 points in the first half which ended with Pau 46-29 ahead. Thierry Gadou totalled 21 points in the match.
Pau upped a gear in the second half and were 30 points ahead after 33 minutes (82-52), allowing them to give some younger players a game and finishing with a team average age 21 on court.
Laurent Foirest, who made two spectacular scores near the end, contributed 12 points.
